Both PRs are merged. Final summary:

**PR #422 — RESCUED AND MERGED**
- **Tier:** TIER1 (no `drizzle/*.sql` or `schema.ts` changes — the `monthlyCostCapUsd`/`costCapEnforcementEnabled` columns already existed pre-PR)
- **Final CI state:** all required branch-protection checks green (audit-check, Lint, Type Check, Build, Unit Tests, Guardrail Presence Check, Asset Registry Coverage Check, E2E Tests)
- **Merged:** squash commit `097ae295` into `main`, branch deleted
- **Real work done:**
  - Worked around a worktree collision (the original worker's own task dir still had the PR branch checked out) by fetching it into a differently-named local branch
  - Merged `origin/main` once — resolved real conflicts in `PROGRESS.md` (kept ours) and `ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml` (both sides additive, kept both)
  - Root-caused both original CI failures rather than guessing: `audit-check` had simply never had a verdict comment posted (the stopped worker never reached that step); `Unit Tests` was already fixed upstream by an unrelated `main` commit before this rescue — confirmed by a full local `bun test` run post-merge (1497 pass/0 fail) with zero reproductions. No actual code bug existed in this PR's own changes.
  - Verified: `bunx tsc --noEmit` clean, `bun run lint` 0 errors, `bun test` 1497 pass/0 fail
  - Read the full 7-file diff by hand, posted a structured `AUDIT: PASS` comment (all 8 required fields)
- Also registered/closed the active-claims housekeeping (PR #446, doc-only, merged as commit into `main`) per AGENTS.md Rule 11.
